<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update sys_domain="global" table="sys_script"><sys_script action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><abort_action>false</abort_action><access>package_private</access><action_delete>true</action_delete><action_insert>true</action_insert><action_query>false</action_query><action_update>true</action_update><active>false</active><add_message>false</add_message><advanced>true</advanced><change_fields>false</change_fields><client_callable>false</client_callable><collection>x_snc_college_pl_0_application</collection><condition/><description/><execute_function>false</execute_function><filter_condition/><is_rest>false</is_rest><message/><name>NEXORA - Update Drive Total Count</name><order>100</order><priority>100</priority><rest_method/><rest_method_text/><rest_service/><rest_service_text/><rest_variables/><role_conditions/><script><![CDATA[(function executeRule(current, previous /*null when async*/) {

    var driveId = '';

    // For Insert / Update
    if (!current.operation() || current.operation() != 'delete') {
        driveId = current.getValue('drive');
    }

    // For Delete
    if (current.operation() == 'delete' && previous) {
        driveId = previous.getValue('drive');
    }

    if (!driveId) {
        return;
    }

    var totalCount = 0;

    var appGR = new GlideRecord('x_snc_college_pl_0_application');
    appGR.addQuery('drive', driveId);
    appGR.query();

    while (appGR.next()) {
        totalCount++;
    }

    var driveGR = new GlideRecord('x_snc_college_pl_0_placement_drive');

    if (driveGR.get(driveId)) {
        driveGR.setValue('total_count', totalCount);
        driveGR.update();
    }

})(current, previous);]]></script><sys_class_name>sys_script</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>admin</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-10-01 05:10:11</sys_created_on><sys_domain>global</sys_domain><sys_domain_path>/</sys_domain_path><sys_id>bcde7adf90e703107f4404b96308c46d</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_name>NEXORA - Update Drive Total Count</sys_name><sys_overrides/><sys_package display_value="College Placement Management System" source="x_snc_college_pl_0">4835026f84db03107f44e79912f3e5cc</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="College Placement Management System">4835026f84db03107f44e79912f3e5cc</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_script_bcde7adf90e703107f4404b96308c46d</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>admin</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-10-01 05:10:11</sys_updated_on><template/><when>before</when></sys_script><sys_translated_text action="delete_multiple" query="documentkey=bcde7adf90e703107f4404b96308c46d"/></record_update>
